notes: When a blowout is done you can Mark Paid right there with Cash, Venmo, Card or Check, and add a check number. It saves a paid invoice and syncs to QuickBooks.
Auto Spread now places same-city stops on a day with room in that city, even when the town is wider than 6 km, instead of leaving them queued.
Helper text is hidden by default. Tap the sparkle in the top bar to show or hide hints, and hold it to open Ask.
The Blowout card has a blue snowflake look, and the Auto Spread day chip fits on one line.
